description: Defines the WindowManager class for managing HTTP/2 flow control windows, including methods for updating window size, buffering data, and notifying listeners.

classes.name: http2::adapter::WindowManager
classes.description: Manages HTTP/2 flow control window, notifies listener when window updates are needed.

methods.name: WindowManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing window manager with size limit, listener, and optional update function.

methods.name: OnWindowSizeLimitChange
methods.description: Handles change in window size limit.

methods.name: SetWindowSizeLimit
methods.description: Sets new window size limit and notifies listener.

methods.name: MarkDataBuffered
methods.description: Increments buffered data and checks window remaining.

methods.name: MarkDataFlushed
methods.description: Updates window after data is flushed or dropped, may notify listener.

methods.name: MarkWindowConsumed
methods.description: Convenience method to mark data as buffered and flushed.

methods.name: IncreaseWindow
methods.description: Increases window size without affecting limit.

methods.name: MaybeNotifyListener
methods.description: Checks conditions and notifies listener if needed.
